scenarios.name: Keep Text Off appearance when switching ribbon tabs

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active with the full Tools ribbon visible in the MCAD Software
the user right-clicks the Tools Options panel title
the Tools command icons are visible without their command labels
the Tools panel titles remain visible
the user selects the 3D Model ribbon tab
the 3D Model command icons are visible without their command labels
the 3D Model panel titles remain visible
the user right-clicks the Modify panel title
Text Off is marked as selected
command labels are visible on the 3D Model ribbon
the user selects the Tools ribbon tab
the full Tools ribbon and its command labels are visible
